$comment: L-1 draft source of truth. Generated pages (docs/pricing.md, docs/limits.md) must match this file. Values mirror GOAL.md D-16/D-17/D-21/D-25/D-64. A write is billed once regardless of views/subscribers (D-22); infrastructure is never claimed free.

writeUnit.replication: Replicating a write to another selected region = +1 write per region, shown up front.
writeUnit.billedOnce: A write is billed once regardless of how many shared views it affects or how many clients are attached (D-22).

storage.definition: Logical bytes (canonical bytes of current documents + retained history, TTL-aware, measured in byte-seconds) x regions, at $/GB-month.

freeTier.notes: Card required at signup (Radar + rate limits). First paid month free if subscribing during onboarding.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Priority support, SOC 2 report access, security questionnaires, DPA/SLA.

branchAllowance: Every org, on any plan, gets 100k writes/month + 1 GB shared across all of its branches (dev branches included) on top of plan quotas; branches beyond it bill like databases.

limits.historyRetention: Default 7 days, configurable per collection 1-30 days (plan-capped at the PITR figure), billed as storage.

abuseGuards._note: Unbilled, enforced, no upsell UI (D-64). CDN-delivered reactive data has no bandwidth guard. Subscribers per view are unlimited on every plan.

reaper: A Free database with no request for 30 days is paused (snapshot kept); at 90 days idle, after two more emails, it is deleted. Paid plans are never reaped (D-76).
